```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(stringr)

# Define custom colors
vet_blue <- "#2a79d5"
vet_teal <- "#29b9d6"

brfss <- read_csv("brfss2022_m62.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Filter veteran groups
veterans <- brfss %>% filter(veteran == "Yes")
non_veterans <- brfss %>% filter(veteran == "No")

```


```{r}
#| label: fig-status-dist
#| fig-cap: "Comparison of sample sizes between Veterans and Non-Veterans."

ggplot(brfss %>% filter(!is.na(veteran)), aes(x = veteran)) +
  geom_bar(fill = vet_blue, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = scales::comma(after_stat(count))), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Veterans vs Non-Veterans",
       x = "Veteran Status",
       y = "Total Count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())

```



```{r}
#| label: fig-log-reg
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-width: 10

# Prepare data
model_data <- brfss %>%
  filter(!is.na(veteran)) %>%
  mutate(
    veteran_bin = as.integer(veteran == "Yes"),
    across(where(is.character), as.factor)
  ) %>%
  select(-veteran, -state, -adults) %>% 
  na.omit()

# Fit model
log_model <- glm(veteran_bin ~ ., data = model_data, family = binomial)

# Extract and format coefficients
coef_df <- as.data.frame(summary(log_model)$coefficients) %>%
  mutate(term = rownames(.)) %>%
  rename(estimate = Estimate, std_error = `Std. Error`, p_value = `Pr(>|z|)`) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
    ci_low  = exp(estimate - 1.96 * std_error),
    ci_high = exp(estimate + 1.96 * std_error),
    significant = p_value < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(estimate))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

# Plot using the custom color scheme
ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = odds_ratio, y = reorder(term, odds_ratio), color = significant)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high), height = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "gray70", "TRUE" = vet_blue),
                     labels = c("Not significant", "p < 0.05")) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 20 Predictors of Veteran Status",
    subtitle = "Odds ratios calculated via logistic regression",
    x = "Odds Ratio (95% CI)",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Significance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
#| label: fig-demographics

#| fig-width: 12
#| label: fig-vet-gender
#| fig-cap: "Gender distribution among surveyed veterans."

ggplot(vets, aes(x = sex)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#29b9d6", width = 0.5) +
  geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = scales::comma(after_stat(count))), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  labs(title = "Veteran Population by Gender", x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```




```{r}
#| label: fig-vet-age
#| fig-cap: "Age distribution of veterans, showing a heavy skew toward older demographics."

#| label: fig-vet-race
#| fig-cap: "Racial demographics of veterans within the dataset."

ggplot(vets, aes(y = reorder(race, race, function(x) length(x)))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#2a79d5") +
  geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = scales::comma(after_stat(count))), 
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
  labs(title = "Veteran Population by Race", x = "Count", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
#| label: fig-education-comparison
#| fig-cap: "Education level distribution by veteran status."

brfss %>%
  filter(!is.na(veteran), !is.na(education)) %>%
  count(veteran, education) %>%
  group_by(veteran) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = education, y = prop, fill = veteran)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 12)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("No" = vet_teal, "Yes" = vet_blue)) +
  labs(
    title = "Education Distribution by Veteran Status",
    x = "Education Level",
    y = "Percent Within Group",
    fill = "Veteran"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))
```
